description: Three-phase DIN-rail multifunction meter with RS485 Modbus RTU and optional LoRaWAN
source: CET, "PMC-350-C Digital Three-Phase LoRaWAN DIN Energy Meter User Manual", V1.4 (2025-12-30), chapter 5 (protocol version 1.3)
notes: Read with FC03, write with FC16; DO control also with FC05.
Big endian: high byte and high word first. Floats are IEEE 754.
Harmonic, TDD and unbalance values have no unit in the manual; the sister PMC-53A sends them as fractions (0.1 = 10 %).
Not in this map: max demand, max/min, monthly energy, freeze, SOE and data recorder logs, setpoint, data recorder, custom data, TOU, LoRaWAN and fire monitoring set-up.
